mapper.select: select id, user_id, device_id, name, token_prefix, scopes, expire_time, revoked_time, last_used_time, cre_time, upd_time from blossom_ai_device_token where user_id = #{userId} order by id desc

select id, user_id, device_id, name, token_prefix, token_hash, scopes, expire_time, revoked_time, last_used_time, cre_time, upd_time from blossom_ai_device_token where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} limit 1

select id, user_id, device_id, name, token_prefix, token_hash, scopes, expire_time, revoked_time, last_used_time, cre_time, upd_time from blossom_ai_device_token where device_id = #{deviceId} and user_id = #{userId} limit 1

select t.id, t.user_id, t.device_id, t.name, t.token_prefix, t.token_hash, t.scopes, t.expire_time, t.revoked_time, t.last_used_time, t.cre_time, t.upd_time, u.username, u.type as user_type, u.del_time as user_del_time from blossom_ai_device_token t join base_user u on u.id = t.user_id where t.device_id = #{deviceId} and t.user_id = #{userId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into blossom_ai_device_token (user_id, device_id, name, token_prefix, token_hash, scopes, expire_time) values (#{userId}, #{deviceId}, #{name}, #{tokenPrefix}, #{tokenHash}, #{scopes}, #{expireTime})
mapper.update: update blossom_ai_device_token set name = #{name}, token_prefix = #{tokenPrefix}, token_hash = #{tokenHash}, scopes = #{scopes}, expire_time = #{expireTime}, revoked_time = null, last_used_time = null, upd_time = now() where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
update blossom_ai_device_token set last_used_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, pid, name, sort from blossom_folder where user_id = #{userId} and type = 1 order by pid, sort, id
select count(1) from blossom_folder where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and type = 1
select id, pid, name, tags, words, version, revision, markdown, html, toc, cre_time, upd_time, user_id from blossom_article where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} limit 1
mapper.update:
update blossom_article
pid = #{folderId}, sort = #{sort}, `name` = #{title}, tags = #{tags},
markdown = #{markdown}, html = #{html}, toc = #{toc}, words = #{words}, version = version + 1, upd_markdown_time = #{markdownUpdatedAt},
revision = revision + 1, upd_time = now()
where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and revision = #{expectedRevision}
mapper.select: select id, user_id, token_id, operation, idempotency_key, request_hash, resource_id, cre_time from blossom_ai_idempotency where token_id = #{tokenId} and operation = #{operation} and idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert ignore into blossom_ai_idempotency (user_id, token_id, operation, idempotency_key, request_hash, resource_id) values (#{userId}, #{tokenId}, #{operation}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestHash}, #{resourceId})
mapper.delete: delete from blossom_ai_idempotency where cre_time < date_sub(now(), interval 24 hour)
mapper.insert: insert into blossom_ai_audit (user_id, token_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, request_id, before_revision, after_revision, result, error_code, ip) values (#{userId}, #{tokenId}, #{action}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{requestId}, #{beforeRevision}, #{afterRevision}, #{result}, #{errorCode}, #{ip})
